'''Vadis Krag''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] and a leader in the [[White Maw]]. During the [[Galactic War]], Krag was present in [[Coldstone Canyon]] when every leader of the White Maw was killed.<ref name="Breaking the Maw" />
